records.criterion: Trace where body length and visible height are limited; distinguish provider truncation from viewport constraints and document the evidence.

evidence.detail: overview-description-layout-study.md traces the 262,144-byte fail-closed admission through accepted projection to the complete plain-text body and the independent 110-pixel Qt viewport cap; no owner/server truncation is inferred.

records.criterion: Compare inline expansion, resizing and a dedicated reading surface across representative widths, fonts, scales, keyboard, selection/copy and scroll ownership.

evidence.detail: The study compares all three options and records 36 full-body native-library probe cases at 800/1400 widths, 13/20-point fonts and 1x/1.25x/2x scale, including full copy, end visibility, PageDown and keyboard return.

records.criterion: Recommend and demonstrate full-body reading, expansion/restoration and Return to Files without losing place; describe short/empty and refresh/replacement behavior.

evidence.detail: The selected retained central reader reaches the complete synthetic body. Its digest-bound source-anchor correction preserves directed selection and keeps the exact anchor visible in 864/864 Return-to-Files/reopen courses; disabled adjustment fails, and short/empty, same-body refresh, edit clamping and authority replacement rules are explicit.

records.criterion: Record a concrete design recommendation and bounded implementation follow-up with runtime acceptance.

evidence.detail: BPR-0928 is canonically allocated and linked to AC-01 with full-body, input, retention, invalidation, accessibility and target-native acceptance; runtime AC-01 remains pending.
